title: The Island That Moved

new_assets.name: small props (chest with band and seal, campfire with cookPot, plank, spyglass, waterskin, foodTray)

input_notes: style variant of SIND-01 (cel-anime-80s); script from Google Sheet "Sinbad Arabian Nights and Ebony Horse" (Drive: ChatGPT Projects/Arabic Stories), tab All Scripts, rows 2-9, read 2026-11-21
plan_warnings: The film is mostly water: the sea kit (openSea, seaY, seaClip) is the biggest piece of work and should be built and checked on stills before any acting.
The whale reveal must read at phone size: at scale 0.55 the eye is only about 30 px across, so the grumpy look at 60.08 needs the eye drawn 1.6x oversize in that wide (or a 0.6 s inset).
Swimming uses the front facing Library person clipped at the water line; check that the crawl arms read and that the tangerine turban stays visible against the blue in every swell.
Pauses are short (0.8 to 1.2 s) and only seven: keep every effect under 0.5 s; the transition at 114.82 is silent.

Wides at zoom 1.0 make faces small (head about 60 px on the 1080 canvas); the acting in wides must be carried by whole body poses, and the three close-ups (40.2 eye, 82.06 grip, 121.52 eyes) carry the faces.
Three new sets plus the sea is above the usual four new assets; they are shared by SIND-02 and SIND-06 (ship, sea, quay, shore), which is why they are specified here.
The English and Arabic scripts match in content (the Arabic adds 'to the port' and 'in the water'); no SCRIPT question.
